To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the fatigue damage mechanism and fatigue life prediction model of unidirectional carbon-fiber-reinforced silicon carbide (C/SiC) ceramic-matrix composite (CMC) at room temperature and high temperature have been investigated.

the tension-tension hysteresis fatigue behavior and the fatigue life of the unidirectional C/ SiC composite at room-temperature and 800 ° C under air have been investigated and predicted by combining the fatigue damage mechanisms with the fibers strength degradation model and interface shear stress degradation models.

the fatigue hystereses of unidirectional ceramic-matrix composite are affected by the interface debonding and sliding and that the fiber/matrix interface debonding is the dominant damage mechanism for the unidirectional ceramic matrix composite under tension-tension fatigue loading at room temperature and high temperature.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the tension-tension low-cycle fatigue behavior of uniaxial tension-tension fatigue of unidirectional ceramic-matrix composite.
the fatigue behavior of uniaxially fiber-reinforced ceramic-matrix composites (CMCs) under tension-tension loading.
the tension-tension cyclic loading behavior of C/SiC composites at room temperature and high temperature under air.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the tension-tension cyclic fatigue life of unidirectional SiC/SiC composite under air atmosphere can be predicted based on the fatigue hystereses loops models, the interface shear stress, the fibers strength and the fibers failure models.
the fatigue damage mechanisms of unidirectional ceramic-matrix composites are the same as those of fiber composites, which can be divided into fiber failure and matrix cracking.

the fatigue hystereses loops models, interface shear stress degradation and fibers strength degradation models, and fibers failure models for the tension-tension cyclic loading of unidirectional fiber-reinforced ceramic-matrix composite are derived.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the fatigue hystereses loops of unidirectional composite can be predicted by using a simple model, which can provide a theoretical basis for the prediction of the fatigue behavior of composite.
the fatigue hystereses loops models and the fatigue life S-N models for unidirectional C/MC composite have been derived.
the fatigue life prediction of unidirectional ceramic-matrix composites is a complex process and needs the combined use of different fatigue damage mechanism models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
fatigue hystereses modulus and fatigue hysterses loss energy can be used to estimate the fatigue life of unidirectional ceramic-matrix composite.

the fatigue hystereses modulus and fatigue hystersis loss energy of unidirectional composite can be used to evaluate the interface shear stress and fibers strength degradation of unidirectional composites.
the fatigue hystereses modulus and fatigue hystersis loss energy can be used to predict the fatigue life of unidirectional fiber-reinforced ceramic-matrix composites.
